title: Stack Profile Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of plugins/<name>/stack.md files. The frontmatter is extracted from between the first --- markers and validated as a JSON object.

allOf.description: Every profile must say how it is detected: stack providers use `detect` (project structure); additive framework providers normally use `dependency` (the orchestrator owns where/how to search) but may use `detect` as an escape hatch.

then.description: Additive (framework) profiles must not declare a workflow. They enrich existing phases; they do not own the pipeline.
The `dependency` shorthand is only for additive framework providers — a stack provider detects by project structure via `detect`.

stack.description: Unique stack name. Lowercase, alphanumeric + hyphens.

priority.description: 0 = vanilla fallback. 100+ = stack provider. Higher wins per aspect. For additive (framework) profiles this is documentational only — additive profiles never compete for an aspect.

additive.description: When true, this is an ADDITIVE (framework) profile: it contributes convention_skills, phase_prompts_injection, extra_phases, and post_pipeline_checks to the merge but is EXCLUDED from per-aspect winner resolution and from PRIMARY_PROFILE selection. Additive profiles MUST NOT declare agents_per_phase or a workflow — they enrich existing agents, they do not own phases. Defaults to false.

dependency.description: Framework providers ONLY: the library coordinate(s) that signal this framework is in use — e.g. 'com.squareup.retrofit2' (group) or 'com.squareup.retrofit2:retrofit' (group:artifact). The plugin just NAMES the dependency; the ORCHESTRATOR owns where and in what order to look for it (version catalog first, then module build files). Prefer this over a hand-written `detect` block. A list matches if ANY coordinate is found.

aspects.description: Aspects this profile owns. Determines per-aspect winner resolution. Additive (framework) profiles use [] — they own no aspect.

workflow.description: Optional. Default workflow recipe this profile selects when it is the PRIMARY profile and neither --workflow=NAME nor sdlc.local.yaml active_workflow is given. Names a workflow recipe (e.g. 'android-feature'). Generic — any profile may declare one.

detect.description: Auto-detect rules. Use `any` for OR, `all` for AND.

file_exists.description: Path (relative to project root) that must exist.

path.description: Path relative to project root. May be a glob (e.g. '**/build.gradle') — if it contains glob characters, the rule matches when ANY globbed file contains the pattern. Glob honors .gitignore.

pattern.description: Regex evaluated against the file contents.

file_glob.description: Glob pattern (relative to project root, e.g. '**/*.kt', '**/build.gradle*'). Matches if at least one file matches. Evaluated with the Glob tool — use for variable-named or nested artifacts (monorepo subtrees, module-level build files).

oneOf.description: Nested OR — matches if any sub-rule matches. Lets a profile compose rules, e.g. '(.kts OR .gradle) AND has Kotlin'.
Nested AND — matches only if every sub-rule matches.
